lines.text:
You can’t become a great Trainer by raising just
one of your Pokémon to be super strong.\c
You’ve gotta develop your whole team evenly,
but that’s no easy task, either.

There’s a narrow trail that leads west out of
Viridian City, right? Have you seen it?\c
It leads to the Pokémon League, the organization
that governs all Pokémon Trainers.
If you’re working on a Pokédex, you should visit\nthe GO Park complex!
There’s a book called Pokémon Journal:\nInterviews.

“The president of the Pokémon Fan Club tells us
about the things he simply can’t get enough of:\c
“‘When you pet a Pokémon, touch it very lightly.
For example, for my Rapidash, I stroke it along
its fur like this...\c
“‘Oh ho! Feel how smooth it is!
It’s like a gentle breeze... It feels so nice!\c
“‘And when you go like so...
Mm-hmm. That’s the best! I could spend my
whole day like this...\c
“‘Oh! I’m sorry!
What was I talking about?’”
